localBiteReport: As of the week of October 30–November 5, 2026, redfish are the standout bite around the Destin/Choctawhatchee Bay area. Captain Adam Schroeder of Ignite The Bite Charters reports schools holding around the bridges, jetties, and Destin Pass, with many fish in the 25–26 inch class and larger bulls mixed in; they've been eating a variety of live baits including pinfish, croakers, spot minnows, and cigar minnows. Speckled trout are also showing well — guides are finding quality fish in the 22–27 inch range near bait concentrations, and artificial lures in deeper water are expected to improve as temperatures cool further. The bay's flats have remained fishable with decent visibility following post-hurricane recovery, with water temperature measured at 75°F. Flounder are in their fall offshore migration, staging near the passes; note that Florida's recreational flounder season in Gulf state waters is closed October 15–November 30, so check regs before keeping any. Half Hitch's Destin report dated November 2 is the most recent local tackle-shop update and confirms active inshore fishing this week.
